question_text: Fill in the blank: 'The memo was addressed ___ the department heads.'

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang partner ng verb
hint_ladder.text: Ang verb na 'address' kapag tungkol sa pagpapadala, laging may ka-pair na preposition. Try mo: 'The letter was addressed ___ me.' Anong salita ang ...

hint_ladder.title: Ang simpleng tuntunin
hint_ladder.text: Kapag tinutukoy mo ang tatanggap ng communication, 'to' ang tamang preposition. Hindi 'for' o 'at'. Ito'y fixed expression: 'addressed to'.

hint_ladder.title: Subukan sa pamilyar na halimbawa
hint_ladder.text: Isipin mong sumusulat ka ng sobre. Lagi mong isinusulat 'To: Juan'. Ganun din sa memo — 'addressed to the department heads'.

hint_ladder.title: Malapit ka na!
hint_ladder.text: Ang tanging natural na preposisyon sa lahat ng halimbawa ay 'to'. Kaya sagot: addressed to.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'for' can show intention, but with 'addressed', the correct partner is 'to'.

B.text: Correct. 'Addressed to' is the idiomatic pair directing communication to the recipient.

C.text: You might have chosen C because 'at' can indicate target, but it's not used for recipients of a message.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'in' shows location/content, but here we need who receives the memo.

next_time_rule: Pag nakita ang 'addressed' at may recipient, isigaw sa isip: 'To!' Parang sobre, 'addressed to' lagi.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo nasa opisina ka ng barangay. May memo kang kailangan ipadala sa lahat ng department heads tungkol sa budget meeting. Sinusulat mo: 'The memo was addressed ___ the department heads.' Yung tamang partner ng verb na 'address' ay 'to' kaya 'addressed to' ang da...

Madaling tandaan: Isipin mo 'yung sobreng susulatan mo. Sa harap, nagsusulat ka ng 'To:' tapos pangalan ng tatanggap. Hindi 'For:' o 'At:' di ba? Kaya tuwing may 'addressed' at susunod ang recipient, i-recall mo lang 'yung sobre — 'addressed to' lagi.
